item.title: Show HN: Arcaide – Explore code with multi-level call graphs
Files over tools: how we built our agent with a virtual filesystem and bash
item.description:
📝 Defining the vision for our agent Our vision was to create an agent that could manage everything that can be accessed from the Knock dashboard. That way, the agent can explore the filesystem to gather context, using bash to efficiently write scripts as needed. In practice, that meant creating a virtual bash implementation in TypeScript with a virtual filesystem that an agent could call.
🔗 Read more: https://knock.app/blog/how-we-built-the-knock-agent-virtual-filesystem-and-bash

item.title: Reverse-engineering Nvidia's CUDA-checkpoint for faster cold starts
item.description:
📝 The utility is called cuda-checkpoint. Watching the process disappear Let’s watch the process disappear from the device. cuda-checkpoint drives a small state machine over the target process; --action lock moves it from running to locked, and then --action checkpoint moves it from locked to checkpointed.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.doubleword.ai/what-happens-when-you-checkpoint-a-cuda-process
